title: Exploratory movement and steering capture
question: Which observed steering windows challenge the current turn-rate model?
hypotheses: Turn rate depends on snake size and boost state as modeled.
Clock mapping, input acceptance or a different turn law explains mismatches.
method: Capture raw inputs and received frames. Export a declared window; compare transmitted anchors with a free simulator replay and report clock/initialization sensitivity.

sampling.selection: One predeclared server and one bounded attempt; retain failures without replacement.
sampling.independence: One invocation provides no independent replication. Frames, lives and concurrent bots are not independent trials.

exclusions: Quarantine corrupt or interrupted recordings; retain their ledger entries and original files.
Label inadequate movement exposure inconclusive instead of retrying until a favorable outcome.
validation: Exploratory only. Any fitted change requires a separate frozen confirmatory plan and held-out acquisition windows.
limitations: Client receipts are not complete server state.
Local send/receipt clocks do not reveal the exact server input-processing tick.
